statement: Price of inference at fixed capability falls >= 10x from 2026 to 2027 (Epoch / AI Index price series; 2027 annual)
status_at_phase_end: Not resolvable in 2024 (resolution window is 2026->2027). Context: 2024 publications and vendor price lists show rapid price declines at fixed capability, with one industry analysis estimating ~10x per year since 2021.

items.summary: A leading frontier developer launched a small model priced at $0.15 / $0.60 per million input/output tokens, described as an order of magnitude cheaper than previous frontier models and more than 60% cheaper than its earlier mid-tier model, while scoring 82% on MMLU.
items.detail: OpenAI, 'GPT-4o mini: advancing cost-efficient intelligence', 2024-07-18 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: A major cloud/model vendor cut prices of its most popular fast model by 78% (input) and 71% (output), to $0.075 / $0.30 per million tokens, effective 12 August.
items.detail: Google Developers Blog, 'Gemini 1.5 Flash price drop with tuning rollout complete, and more', 2024-08-08 (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: Industry analysis of archived price lists: for an LLM of equivalent performance (fixed MMLU threshold), cost fell ~10x per year; the cheapest model scoring >= 42 MMLU went from $60 to $0.06 per million tokens in three years (~1,000x).
items.detail: a16z (Guido Appenzeller), 'Welcome to LLMflation - LLM inference cost is going down fast', November 2024 (page verified via web_extract this run; exact day taken from the post's November 2024 asset paths and listing, not shown in extracted text). Venture-investor analysis, not an official series; limited to OpenAI, Anthropic and Llama models.
items.value: ~10x per year decline at fixed capability

items.summary: No official or research-tracker price-at-fixed-capability series with a stated methodology was found published within 2024 in this run; 2024 evidence consists of vendor price lists and one industry analysis.
items.detail: Epoch AI's dedicated inference-price analysis appeared only after the phase window and is excluded under the as-of rule. Reference page opened: a16z LLMflation post (only 2024 series located).
